text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-m-i-t-t-e-d r-a-d-i-o s-i-g-n-a-l-s t-o m-i-m-i-c g-p-s f-a-i-l-u-r-e, l-e-f-t l-o-g f-i-l-e-s i-n t-h-e t-e-s-t l-a-b, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e a-u-d-i-t.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d a b-l-u-e-t-o-o-t h-i-d-d-e-n n-e-a-r t-h-e d-r-o-n-e h-a-r-b-o-r, l-e-f-t b-a-t-t-e-r-y r-e-m-a-i-n-d-e-r s-t-i-c-k-e-r-s o-n t-h-e d-e-s-k, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e s-e-c-u-r-i-t-y c-l-e-a-r-a-n-c-e f-o-r u-n-a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-o-w-n-l-o-a-d-e-d d-r-o-n-e f-l-i-g-h-t p-a-t-h d-a-t-a, l-e-f-t a n-a-m-e-d c-o-p-y o-n t-h-e s-h-a-r-e-d d-r-i-v-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d e-n-c-r-y-p-t-i-o-n o-f s-t-o-r-e-d f-l-i-g-h-t r-e-c-o-r-d-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-p-o-r-t-e-d a s-i-g-n-a-l g-l-i-t-c-h t-o t-h-e s-u-p-p-o-r-t t-e-a-m, l-e-f-t t-h-e t-i-c-k-e-t i-n t-h-e c-l-o-s-e-d c-a-t-e-g-o-r-y, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e o-p-e-r-a-t-o-r-s s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r t-o-o-k p-h-o-t-o-g-r-a-p-h-s o-f t-h-e l-a-n-d-i-n-g z-o-n-e l-a-t-e r-a-c-e-t-h-e e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e, l-e-f-t m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a o-n t-h-e p-h-o-n-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e d-a-t-a r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n p-o-l-i-c-y c-h-e-c-k.
